description: policy.why explains a verdict and writes NOTHING (D9): the sentence is Verdict.Sentence() verbatim — the one formatter every surface prints, never a socket-shaped paraphrase. `type` is the one required member (an explanation with no question is not an answer); `at` dates the answer so the expiry boundary is explorable without waiting. `unimplemented` is the field an app branches on (SEC-033): "nobody can answer this yet" and "a rule refused you" share the "refused: " prefix, and a client that parses prose has already collapsed the three answers into two.
